mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(COUNT(DISTINCT ss.student_id),0) AS totalStudents, COALESCE(AVG(ss.score),0) AS avgScore, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN ss.score >= 60 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) AS passStudent, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN ss.score < 60 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) AS failCount, COALESCE(COUNT(ss.score),0) AS totalRecord

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN ss.score >= 90 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) AS excellentCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN ss.score BETWEEN 80 AND 89 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) AS goodCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN ss.score BETWEEN 70 AND 79 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) AS mediumCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN ss.score BETWEEN 60 AND 69 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) AS passCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN ss.score < 60 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) AS failCount

SELECT stu.username AS studentNo, stu.real_name AS studentName, c.name AS courseName, ss.score AS totalScore, '成绩低于60分，判定为异常成绩' AS reason
AND ss.score < 60

SELECT sr.student_id AS studentId, su.username AS studentNo, su.real_name AS studentName, COALESCE(oc.name, '未分配班级') AS className, ss.id, ss.usual_score AS usualScore, ss.final_score AS finalScore, ss.score, ss.remark FROM selection_record sr LEFT JOIN sys_user su ON sr.student_id = su.id AND su.role = 'student' LEFT JOIN org_class oc ON su.class_id = oc.id LEFT JOIN student_score ss ON sr.student_id = ss.student_id AND sr.course_id = ss.course_id AND ss.status = 1 WHERE sr.course_id = #{courseId} AND sr.status = 1 ORDER BY su.username ASC
mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO student_score ( course_id, student_id, teacher_id, score, usual_score, final_score, remark, status, create_time, update_time ) VALUES
( #{courseId}, #{item.studentId}, #{item.teacherId}, #{item.score}, #{item.usualScore}, #{item.finalScore}, #{item.remark}, #{item.status}, #{item.createTime}, #{item.updateTime} )
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE teacher_id = VALUES(teacher_id), score = VALUES(score), usual_score = VALUES(usual_score), final_score = VALUES(final_score), remark = VALUES(remark), status = VALUES(status), update_time = VALUES(update_time)
mapper.select:
SELECT s.username AS studentNo, s.real_name AS studentName, oc.name AS className, ss.usual_score AS usualScore, ss.final_score AS finalScore, ROUND(ss.usual_score * 0.3 + ss.final_score * 0.7) AS totalScore, CASE WHEN ROUND(ss.usual_score * 0.3 + ss.final_score * 0.7) >= 90 THEN '优秀' WHEN ROUND(ss.usual_score * 0.3 + ss.final_score * 0.7) >= 80 THEN '良好' WHEN ROUND(ss.usual_score * 0.3 + ss.final_score * 0.7) >= 70 THEN '中等' WHEN ROUND(ss.usual_score * 0.3 + ss.final_score * 0.7) >= 60 THEN '及格' ELSE '不及格' END AS level, CASE WHEN ROUND(ss.usual_score * 0.3 + ss.final_score * 0.7) >= 60 THEN '及格' ELSE '不及格' END AS status, ss.remark AS remark FROM student_score ss INNER JOIN sys_user s ON ss.student_id = s.id INNER JOIN org_class oc ON s.class_id = oc.id INNER JOIN course c ON ss.course_id = c.id
AND ss.course_id = #{courseId}
AND c.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{courseName}, '%')
AND ss.usual_score IS NOT NULL AND ss.final_score IS NOT NULL AND ss.status = 1 AND s.role = 'student'
ORDER BY s.username ASC
